chapter.heading: 1 Thessalonians 4
A Life Pleasing to God
chapter.v: 4 Finally, then, brothers, we ask and urge you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, just as you are doing, that youdo so more and more.
you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.
that you abstain from sexual immorality;
an avenger in all these things, as we told you beforehand and solemnly warned you.
who gives his Holy Spirit to you.
Now concerning brotherly love you have no need for anyone to write to you, for you yourselves have been taught by Godto love one another,
to work with your hands, as we instructed you,
outsiders and be dependent on no one.
the coming of the Lord, will not precede those who have fallen asleep.
the dead in Christ will rise first.
we will always be with the Lord.
Therefore encourage one another with these words.
